QuestInfo.name: In Search of the Flame
QuestInfo.0: You eliminated the #o4230112#s and proved yourself to #p1033227#. Is he satisfied now? Only one way to find out!
QuestInfo.1: #p1033227# says the Flame of Revival can remove any curse. Hurry to the #bsecret entrance#k he spoke of. It should be in #b#m105010100##k of #b#m105000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: There was no Flame of Revival. It was a Black Wing ambush! #p1033227# is nowhere to be found. It was all a trick!

0.0: You'll find the Flame of Revival on #b#m105010100##k of #b#m105000000##k. Go on, then! There's nothing to be scared of! Just get over there as fast as you can. No time to prepare!
0.1: The Flame of Revival, the gift that can remove any curse, is just inside. There's nothing dangerous in there, so you might as well put your weapons away. It's just the path here that's dangerous. In you go!

yes.0: I don't need to go in with you, do I? I'll be right here. Now hurry up and get the Flame of Revival!

no.0: Aren't you going inside? It's fine! Just go! I don't have all day!
